name: Spiral notebook
definition: Notebook bound with a wire or plastic spiral so pages turn flat or fold back; size, ruling and subject count are attributes.

name: Pocket notebook
definition: Small notebook that fits a pocket (about A6 or smaller), sold singly or in packs; Field Notes is a named form.

name: Wall calendar
definition: Calendar hung on a wall, showing a year of months, usually one month per page.

name: Desk calendar
definition: Calendar that stands or lies on a desk, as a tent, easel or day-to-day pad.
